title: probes.json
description: Per-batch L4 behavioral-probe + network-whitelist results (scheme §6). Records, per config: contract-IN probes (three-valued pass/indeterminate/fail — error-state language-independent verdict + parameter-correctness URL serial assertion), network-whitelist violations (the exactly-one initial document URL + same-origin GET /api/om/forecast /api/om/archive policy; ws/wss blocked; service worker + browser cache disabled; data:/blob: legal; everything else = violation+blocked), contract-OUT neutral observations (observed/not-observed/n-a, NOT in the pass rate), plus the effort-parameter-reached-API probe (MODEL-MATRIX §3 warning: the configured effort/thinking parameter may silently NOT reach the vendor API) and served_model verification. JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme §6 fixes the probe SEMANTICS and the three verdict vocabularies but not the JSON shape; the object layout below is this contract's design. probes.json is OBSERVATIONAL (screenshots, timings, some non-deterministic) and is EXCLUDED from every verify rehash (scheme §0). schema_version 1.0.0; file SHA256 + version frozen into lock (scheme §11).
$comment: schema_version: 1.0.0. Vocabularies are LAW (scheme §6): contract-in verdict = {pass,indeterminate,fail}; contract-out observation = {observed,not-observed,n-a}. effort_reached_api and served_model verdicts are this contract's design (flagged). No decimal-string discipline needed: probes.json never enters a verify hash.

network_whitelist.description: The frozen network policy applied during shoot (scheme §6 网络管控). Declarative record of the allowlist; per-config outcomes are under configs[].network.

initial_document_url.description: The exactly-one whitelisted harness initial document URL (scheme §6: '恰好一次 harness 初始文档 URL').

allowed_api_endpoints.description: The two same-origin GET endpoints allowed (exact path match), scheme §6.

policy.description: Fixed policy switches (scheme §6). Constant across the batch; recorded for auditability.

other_requests.description: Every other request (incl. same-origin static assets) is a violation and blocked.

configs.description: One probe record per config (persisted manifest config_ids order; use sites never re-sort).

contract_in.description: Contract-IN probes; verdicts feed the pass rate (scheme §6).

error_state.description: Error-injection behavior, language-independent three-valued (scheme §6): pass = non-blank ∧ NO canary data shown ∧ error-vocab hit; indeterminate = non-blank ∧ no canary ∧ error-vocab MISS (screenshot attached); fail = blank OR fabricated data presented.

screenshot_ref.description: Path to the attached screenshot (required evidence for indeterminate per scheme §6); null when not applicable.

allOf.$comment: scheme §6: indeterminate = non-blank ∧ no canary ∧ error-vocab MISS (附截图). The screenshot is MANDATORY evidence, so screenshot_ref must be a non-null string when verdict=indeterminate.

param_correctness.description: Parameter-correctness = URL serial assertion (scheme §6). If the request-side extraction is ambiguous/not-found → indeterminate.

url_assertions.description: Per-key assertion over the contract query (endpoint, lat/lon ±0.01, start/end_date, daily/hourly field sets, timezone=UTC, temperature_unit=celsius).

network.description: Network-whitelist outcome for this config's renders. Any off-allowlist request (incl. same-origin static assets, ws/wss, non-exact API paths, disallowed redirect hops) is a violation and was blocked; presence of any violation also raises the 'network-violation' slot flag (scheme §6, §7).

method.description: HTTP method if applicable, else null (e.g. ws/wss).

contract_out.description: Contract-OUT neutral observations (scheme §6). observed/not-observed/n-a; NEVER enter the pass rate.

in_page_race.description: In-page race — only run when a switch control is detected (else n-a).

effort_reached_api.description: Effort-parameter-reached-API probe (MODEL-MATRIX §3 WARNING): verifies the configured effort/thinking parameter was actually transmitted to and accepted by the vendor API, rather than silently dropped by an SDK/proxy/gateway. JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): shape is this contract's design.

verdict.description: reached = effort provably present in the on-wire request / echoed by the API; not-reached = provably absent; indeterminate = no observable signal either way; n-a = config.effort is null (model has no effort axis).

requested_effort.description: The effort value config.json set (opaque per-vendor string), or null.

observed_effort.description: Effort value observed on the wire / in the API echo, or null when unobservable.

served_model.description: Served-model verification (BRIEF R3/R8): the model id the vendor reports as actually serving vs the requested model_id. A mismatch is a RECORDED confound, never silently corrected (scheme §10). Mirrors config.json.served_model; here as the probe evidence.

verdict.description: match = served == requested; mismatch = differs (recorded confound); unknown = vendor exposes no served-model signal.

served_model.description: Vendor-reported served model id, or null when no signal.

contractInVerdict.description: Contract-IN three-valued verdict (scheme §6). Feeds the pass rate.

contractOutObs.description: Contract-OUT neutral observation (scheme §6): observed / not-observed / n-a. Never in the pass rate.

note.description: Optional evidence/screenshot ref or reason, or null.
